card.name: Word endings in drug label terms
card.fires_on: The last piece of a noun in drug label text, such as 'product' after 'this', or the ending of a longer term like microspheres, glycosylated, mesylate or metabolite.

modes.label: Product after this
modes.description: The word 'product' ending a phrase about discussing risks and benefits with the patient.
modes.example: The physician should discuss the risks and benefits of this<< product>> with the patient.
